theme.text: "Real Talk Nights": Intimate stand-up showcasing comedians known for bold, spontaneous, no-filter observations.
"Up Close Comedy": Small-room format emphasizing the casual, conversational connection between performer and audience.
"The Funny Truth": A series centring comedians whose humor riffs on everyday life and relationships with unfiltered authenticity.

merch.text: Branded performance tee ('Joe List Live Tour' + dates) – appeals to audiences valuing casual, wearable comedy fan gear.
Comedy notebook or journal ('Bold & Spontaneous Notes') – merchandise that resonates with audiences interested in humor and personal expression.
Comedy tour stickers or pins – lightweight, affordable collectibles for casual fans to display and share.
